source_policy: No normative numeric value is accepted without a licensed, traceable source; this audit does not invent one.

E01.implemented_assertion: Explicit room area, perimeter, type and load data are required; no lighting/TUG minimum is inferred.
E01.test_evidence: golden deterministic input; malformed room/load negative cases inherited through input contract
missing: space-type golden cases derived from an authorized source

E02.implemented_assertion: SINGLE/THREE topology, positive voltage, units VA/KVA/W/KW and power factor for active-power conversion are validated.
E02.test_evidence: zero voltage and invalid topology rejected; W without power factor rejected
E02.traceable_source: mathematical current relation only; no normative topology source
missing: authorized topology and supply voltage evidence

E03.implemented_assertion: Demand factor must be explicit, between zero and one, and accompanied by a source reference; otherwise the result stays pending.
E03.test_evidence: deterministic golden case with synthetic reference
E03.traceable_source: SYNTHETIC-DEMAND-1 is a test identifier, not a normative source

E04.implemented_assertion: Cable section, ampacity and correction factor must be explicitly supplied, selected section must exist in the provided catalogue, and catalogue requires a source reference.
E04.test_evidence: missing catalogue yields pending rather than approval
E04.traceable_source: SYNTHETIC-CABLE-1 is a test identifier, not a normative source
missing: installation, material, temperature and grouping evidence

E05.implemented_assertion: R/X, length and PF are explicit; numerical zero is retained as a value and never mistaken for missing data; source reference is mandatory for a calculation result.
E05.test_evidence: zero R/X golden negative-boundary case produces zero drop; missing source remains pending
E05.traceable_source: SYNTHETIC-RX-1 is a test identifier, not a normative source

independent_existing_evidence.statement: Existing E01-E11 evidence proves development arithmetic and fail-closed guards, not electrical conformity.

recommended_next: Integrate the GREENFIELD input contract into API routes only after an independent API reviewer confirms the existing route contract; obtain licensed sources before enabling any normative result.
